forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: c680
+title: 'XML injection: agent and skill names/descriptions are interpolated unescaped into tool descriptions'
+---
+`build_description` in both `crates/swissarmyhammer-tools/src/mcp/tools/agent/mod.rs` and `.../skill/mod.rs` interpolates library-supplied strings straight into XML:
+
+```rust
+xml.push_str(&format!(
+    "<agent>\n  <name>{}</name>\n  <description>{}</description>\n  <location>{}</location>\n</agent>\n",
+    agent.name, agent.description, agent.source
+));
+```
+
+No escaping. A name or description containing `<`, `>`, `&`, or a literal `</agent>` breaks the structure or injects markup into the tool description the model reads.
+
+Split out of ^6xjxebg. Pre-existing — that commit only added `cli_category` to each file. This is the **only security-class finding** in that card's 54, which is why it gets its own card rather than being folded into a style sweep.
+
+## Why it matters
+
+The tool description goes into the model's context. An agent or skill sourced from a marketplace, a plugin, or a user directory controls these strings. Injected markup can forge `<agent>` entries the operator never installed.
+
+## Required change
+
+1. Escape the five XML entities (`&` first, then `<`, `>`, `"`, `'`) on every interpolated value in both files.
+2. One shared helper, not a copy per file — the two `build_description` functions are already near-duplicates.
+3. Consider whether these should be built with a serializer rather than `format!`; hand-built markup is what produced the bug.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- A test with an agent named `</agent><agent><name>forged` proves the output is inert. Prove RED first.
+- Same for a description containing `&` and `<`.
+- Both files use the same helper.
+- `cargo nextest run -E 'rdeps(swissarmyhammer-tools)'`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
+
+Note: `crates/swissarmyhammer-agents/src/format.rs::to_agent_md` has the same hand-concatenation problem in YAML, filed as ^ksys4z5. Related cause, different file — do not merge the cards, but the same escaping discipline applies.
\ No newline at end of file
